<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="de">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>SnackBreak — Vending-Service für Gewerbekunden</title>

<meta property="og:type" content="website">

<meta property="og:site_name" content="SnackBreak">

<meta property="og:description" content="Snack- und Getränkeautomaten für Unternehmen — kostenlose Aufstellung, persönlicher Ansprechpartner, unverbindliches Angebot. Rhein-Erft-Kreis, Köln, Düsseldorf.">

<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<meta name="twitter:title" content="SnackBreak — Ihr zuverlässiger Partner für die Teamverpflegung">
<meta name="twitter:description" content="Snack- und Getränkeautomaten für Unternehmen — kostenlose Aufstellung, persönlicher Ansprechpartner, unverbindliches Angebot.">
<meta name="twitter:image" content="snackbreak-og-image.jpg">

<link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="32x32" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" sizes="180x180" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@500;600&display=swap');

:root{
  --ink:#12203A;
  --ink-soft:#1E3157;
  --paper:#F5F6F8;
  --paper-raised:#FFFFFF;
  --steel:#5C6B82;
  --line:#DCE1E9;
  --amber:#FF7A1A;
  --amber-deep:#E0630A;
  --amber-tint:#FFE9D6;
  --radius:14px;
  --maxw:1160px;
}

*{box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0;}

html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}

body{
  font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
  background:var(--paper);
  color:var(--ink);
  line-height:1.55;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}

h1,h2,h3, .display{
  font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;
  font-weight:600;
  letter-spacing:-0.01em;
  color:var(--ink);
}

.mono{
  font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;
  letter-spacing:0.02em;
}

a{color:inherit; text-decoration:none;}

img{max-width:100%; display:block;}

.wrap{
  max-width:var(--maxw);
  margin:0 auto;
  padding:0 28px;
}

:focus-visible{
  outline:3px solid var(--amber);
  outline-offset:3px;
}

/* ---------- header ---------- */
header{
  position:sticky; top:0; z-index:50;
  background:rgba(245,246,248,0.92);
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
}
.header-inner{
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
  padding:16px 28px;
  max-width:var(--maxw); margin:0 auto;
}
.logo{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px;
}
.logo-mark{
  width:44px; height:44px;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  position:relative;
  flex-shrink:0;
}
.logo-mark img{
  width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain;
}
.logo-text{display:flex; flex-direction:column; line-height:1.05;}
.logo-text .name{font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:19px;}
.logo-text .tag{font-size:11px; color:var(--steel); letter-spacing:0.04em;}

nav{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:32px;}
nav a.navlink{
  font-size:14.5px; font-weight:500; color:var(--ink-soft);
  transition:color .15s ease;
}
nav a.navlink:hover{color:var(--amber-deep);}

.btn{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px;
  padding:12px 22px;
  border-radius:100px;
  font-weight:600; font-size:14.5px;
  transition:transform .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease, background .15s ease;
  cursor:pointer; border:none;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.btn-primary{
  background:var(--amber); color:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(255,122,26,0.32);
}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--amber-deep); transform:translateY(-1px);}
.btn-outline{
  background:transparent; color:var(--ink); border:1.5px solid var(--line);
}
.btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--ink); transform:translateY(-1px);}
.btn-ghost-light{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color:#fff; border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
}
.btn-ghost-light:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.2);}

.hamburger{display:none;}

/* ---------- hero ---------- */
.hero{
  background:var(--ink);
  background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 82% 18%, #1E3157 0%, var(--ink) 55%);
  color:#fff;
  padding:76px 0 90px;
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
}
.hero-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1.05fr 0.85fr;
  gap:56px;
  align-items:center;
}
.eyebrow{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
  font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;
  font-size:12.5px; font-weight:500;
  color:var(--amber);
  background:rgba(255,122,26,0.12);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,122,26,0.35);
  padding:7px 14px; border-radius:100px;
  margin-bottom:22px;
}
.eyebrow::before{content:"●"; font-size:8px;}

.hero h1{
  font-size:clamp(34px, 4.6vw, 54px);
  line-height:1.08;
  color:#fff;
  margin-bottom:22px;
}
.hero h1 em{
  font-style:normal;
  color:var(--amber);
}
.hero p.lead{
  font-size:17px;
  color:#C6CEDD;
  max-width:480px;
  margin-bottom:22px;
}
.slogan{
  font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;
  font-style:italic;
  font-weight:600;
  font-size:17px;
  color:var(--amber);
  margin-bottom:30px;
  position:relative;
  padding-left:18px;
}
.slogan::before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  left:0; top:4px; bottom:4px;
  width:3px;
  background:var(--amber);
  border-radius:2px;
}
.hero-ctas{display:flex; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:38px;}

.hero-microtrust{
  display:flex; gap:26px; flex-wrap:wrap;
  font-size:13px; color:#8D9AB3;
}
.hero-microtrust span{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px;}
.hero-microtrust b{color:#fff; font-weight:600;}

/* photo showcase (hero) */
.photo-showcase{
  position:relative;
  padding:14px 26px 34px 6px;
}
.showcase-main{
  width:100%;
  aspect-ratio:4/3;
  object-fit:cover;
  border-radius:20px;
  box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  display:block;
}
.showcase-secondary{
  position:absolute;
  width:46%;
  bottom:-6px; left:-16px;
  aspect-ratio:4/3;
  object-fit:cover;
  border-radius:14px;
  box-shadow:0 18px 34px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  border:4px solid var(--ink);
}
.showcase-badge{
  position:absolute;
  top:-16px; right:0;
  background:var(--amber);
  color:#fff;
  font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;
  font-weight:700;
  font-size:13.5px;
  padding:12px 18px;
  border-radius:12px;
  box-shadow:0 14px 28px rgba(255,122,26,0.4);
  transform:rotate(3deg);
  max-width:200px;
  line-height:1.3;
}

/* ---------- trust bar ---------- */
.trustbar{
  background:var(--paper-raised);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  padding:30px 0;
}
.trustbar-inner{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:34px; flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.trustbar-label{
  font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;
  font-size:12px; color:var(--steel);
  letter-spacing:0.04em;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.trust-logos{display:flex; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap; flex:1; align-items:center;}
.trust-chip{
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:10px;
  padding:14px 22px;
  font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;
  font-weight:600; font-size:14.5px;
  color:var(--ink-soft);
  background:var(--paper);
  display:flex; align-items:center;
  height:64px;
}
.trust-chip img{
  max-height:34px;
  max-width:150px;
  width:auto;
  height:auto;
  filter:grayscale(100%) opacity(0.75);
  transition:filter .2s ease;
}
.trust-chip:hover img{
  filter:grayscale(0%) opacity(1);
}

/* ---------- sections ---------- */
section{padding:88px 0;}
.section-head{
  max-width:640px;
  margin-bottom:52px;
}
.section-eyebrow{
  font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;
  font-size:12.5px; color:var(--amber-deep);
  font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.05em;
  margin-bottom:14px;
  display:block;
}
.section-head h2{
  font-size:clamp(26px,3.2vw,36px);
  margin-bottom:16px;
}
.section-head p{color:var(--steel); font-size:16px;}

/* leistungen */
.services-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap:20px;
}
.service-card{
  background:var(--paper-raised);
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--radius);
  padding:26px;
  transition:transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, border-color .18s ease;
}
.service-card:hover{
  transform:translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(18,32,58,0.08);
  border-color:#C6CEDD;
}
.service-card .slot{
  font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;
  font-size:12.5px; font-weight:600;
  color:#fff; background:var(--ink);
  width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:8px;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  margin-bottom:16px;
}
.service-card h3{font-size:17px; margin-bottom:9px;}
.service-card p{font-size:14.5px; color:var(--steel);}

/* frischer genuss */
.fresh{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:56px;
  align-items:center;
}
.fresh-photo{
  border-radius:20px;
  overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(18,32,58,0.16);
}
.fresh-photo img{
  width:100%;
  aspect-ratio:3/2;
  object-fit:cover;
  display:block;
}
.fresh-text p{color:var(--steel); font-size:16px; margin-bottom:16px;}
.fresh-list{list-style:none; margin-top:20px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px;}
.fresh-list li{
  display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px;
  font-size:14.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); font-weight:500;
}
.fresh-list li::before{
  content:"";
  width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--amber);
  margin-top:8px;
  flex-shrink:0;
}

/* ablauf */
.process{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
  gap:0;
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--radius);
  overflow:hidden;
  background:var(--paper-raised);
}
.process-step{
  padding:34px 30px;
  position:relative;
}
.process-step:not(:last-child){border-right:1px solid var(--line);}
.process-step .num{
  font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;
  font-size:13px; color:var(--amber-deep); font-weight:600;
  margin-bottom:14px;
}
.process-step h3{font-size:17px; margin-bottom:10px;}
.process-step p{font-size:14.5px; color:var(--steel);}

/* ueber uns */
.about{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:56px;
  align-items:center;
}
.about p{color:var(--steel); font-size:16px; margin-bottom:16px;}
.about-stats{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:14px;
}
.stat{
  background:var(--paper-raised);
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--radius);
  padding:22px;
}
.stat .num{
  font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif; font-weight:700;
  font-size:28px; color:var(--ink);
  margin-bottom:4px;
}
.stat .lbl{font-size:13px; color:var(--steel);}

.founders{margin-top:24px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px;}
.founder-row{
  display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;
  font-size:14.5px;
  border-top:1px solid var(--line);
  padding-top:10px;
}
.founder-row b{color:var(--ink);}
.founder-row a{color:var(--amber-deep); font-weight:600;}

/* marken partner */
.brands-strip{
  display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:18px;
  justify-content:center;
  align-items:stretch;
}
.brand-logo-card{
  background:var(--paper-raised);
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:14px;
  padding:20px 28px;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  height:84px;
  transition:border-color .2s ease, transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease;
}
.brand-logo-card:hover{
  border-color:var(--amber);
  transform:translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(18,32,58,0.08);
}
.brand-logo-card img{
  max-height:38px;
  max-width:140px;
  width:auto;
  height:auto;
  object-fit:contain;
}

/* automaten uebersicht */
.machines-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap:20px;
}
.machine-card{
  background:var(--paper-raised);
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--radius);
  padding:0;
  overflow:hidden;
  transition:transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, border-color .18s ease;
}
.machine-card:hover{
  transform:translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(18,32,58,0.08);
  border-color:#C6CEDD;
}
.machine-card .icon-area{
  background:var(--ink);
  background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 75% 20%, #1E3157 0%, var(--ink) 60%);
  height:120px;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  overflow:hidden;
}
.machine-card .icon-area svg{
  width:88px; height:88px;
}
.machine-card .body{
  padding:22px 22px 26px;
}
.machine-card h3{font-size:16px; margin-bottom:8px;}
.machine-card p{font-size:14px; color:var(--steel);}

/* faq */
.faq-list{
  display:flex; flex-direction:column;
  gap:12px;
  max-width:820px;
}
.faq-item{
  background:var(--paper-raised);
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--radius);
  overflow:hidden;
}
.faq-item summary{
  list-style:none;
  cursor:pointer;
  padding:20px 24px;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
  gap:16px;
  font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;
  font-weight:600; font-size:16px;
  color:var(--ink);
}
.faq-item summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none;}
.faq-item summary::after{
  content:"+";
  font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;
  font-size:20px; font-weight:400;
  color:var(--amber-deep);
  flex-shrink:0;
  transition:transform .2s ease;
}
.faq-item[open] summary::after{transform:rotate(45deg);}
.faq-item .faq-answer{
  padding:0 24px 20px;
  font-size:14.5px;
  color:var(--steel);
  max-width:640px;
}

/* kontakt-formular wizard */
.wizard-card{
  background:var(--paper-raised);
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:20px;
  padding:40px 44px;
  max-width:720px;
  margin:0 auto;
  box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(18,32,58,0.08);
}
.wizard-progress{
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  gap:0; margin-bottom:36px;
}
.wizard-step-dot{
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:6px;
  font-size:12px; color:var(--steel); font-weight:600;
  min-width:76px;
}
.wizard-step-dot span{
  width:32px; height:32px; border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--paper);
  border:2px solid var(--line);
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif; font-weight:700;
  color:var(--steel);
  transition:background .2s ease, border-color .2s ease, color .2s ease;
}
.wizard-step-dot.active span{
  background:var(--amber); border-color:var(--amber); color:#fff;
}
.wizard-step-dot.done span{
  background:var(--ink); border-color:var(--ink); color:#fff;
}
.wizard-step-dot.active{color:var(--ink);}
.wizard-step-line{
  flex:1; height:2px; background:var(--line);
  margin:0 4px; margin-bottom:22px;
  max-width:60px;
}
.wizard-panel{display:none;}
.wizard-panel.active{display:block; animation:fadeInPanel .25s ease;}
@keyframes fadeInPanel{from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(6px);} to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0);}}
.wizard-panel h3{
  font-size:19px; margin-bottom:20px;
}
.branche-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap:12px;
}
.branche-card{
  position:relative;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; gap:8px;
  border:1.5px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:12px;
  padding:18px 16px;
  cursor:pointer;
  transition:border-color .15s ease, background .15s ease;
}
.branche-card:hover{border-color:#C6CEDD;}
.branche-card input{
  position:absolute; opacity:0; width:1px; height:1px;
}
.branche-card .branche-icon{font-size:22px;}
.branche-card span:last-child{
  font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:14.5px;
  color:var(--ink);
}
.branche-card:has(input:checked){
  border-color:var(--amber);
  background:var(--amber-tint);
}
.form-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:16px;
}
.form-field{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px;}
.form-field-full{grid-column:1 / -1;}
.form-field span{
  font-size:13px; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink-soft);
}
.form-field input, .form-field select, .form-field textarea{
  font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
  font-size:14.5px;
  padding:11px 14px;
  border:1.5px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:9px;
  background:var(--paper);
  color:var(--ink);
  transition:border-color .15s ease;
  resize:vertical;
}
.form-field input:focus, .form-field select:focus, .form-field textarea:focus{
  outline:none; border-color:var(--amber);
}
.wizard-actions{
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
  margin-top:28px;
}
.wizard-note{
  font-size:12.5px; color:var(--steel);
  text-align:center; margin-top:16px;
}
.wizard-error{
  color:#D0421B; font-size:13px; margin-top:10px; display:none;
}
.wizard-alt-submit{
  display:flex; justify-content:center; margin-top:12px;
}
.wizard-alt-submit button{
  background:none; border:none; color:var(--steel);
  font-size:13px; text-decoration:underline; cursor:pointer;
  font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
}
.wizard-alt-submit button:hover{color:var(--amber-deep);}

/* kontakt */
.kontakt{
  background:var(--ink);
  background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 15% 85%, #1E3157 0%, var(--ink) 55%);
  color:#fff;
  border-radius:24px;
  padding:64px 52px;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:48px;
}
.kontakt h2{color:#fff; font-size:clamp(26px,3vw,34px); margin-bottom:14px;}
.kontakt p.lead{color:#C6CEDD; font-size:16px; margin-bottom:28px; max-width:420px;}
.contact-cards{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px;}
.contact-card{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
  border-radius:12px;
  padding:18px 20px;
  display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:14px;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.contact-card .who{font-weight:600; font-size:15px; margin-bottom:3px;}
.contact-card .num{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:13.5px; color:#8D9AB3;}
.contact-actions{display:flex; gap:8px;}
.icon-btn{
  width:38px; height:38px; border-radius:9px;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
  transition:background .15s ease;
}
.icon-btn:hover{background:var(--amber);}
.icon-btn svg{width:17px; height:17px;}

.kontakt-right{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:16px;}
.email-card{
  background:rgba(255,122,26,0.12);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,122,26,0.4);
  border-radius:14px;
  padding:26px;
}
.email-card .lbl{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:12px; color:var(--amber); margin-bottom:8px;}
.email-card .addr{font-size:18px; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:16px; word-break:break-word;}
.region-card{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
  border-radius:14px;
  padding:22px 24px;
  font-size:14px; color:#C6CEDD;
}
.region-card b{color:#fff; display:block; margin-bottom:6px; font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;}

/* legal pages */
.legal-page{
  max-width:760px;
  margin:0 auto;
  padding:64px 28px 40px;
}
.legal-page h1{
  font-size:clamp(26px,3.4vw,36px);
  margin-bottom:8px;
}
.legal-page .legal-updated{
  font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;
  font-size:12.5px;
  color:var(--steel);
  margin-bottom:40px;
  display:block;
}
.legal-page h2{
  font-size:19px;
  margin-top:40px;
  margin-bottom:14px;
  color:var(--ink);
}
.legal-page h3{
  font-size:15.5px;
  margin-top:22px;
  margin-bottom:8px;
  color:var(--ink-soft);
}
.legal-page p{
  font-size:15px;
  color:var(--ink-soft);
  margin-bottom:14px;
}
.legal-page ul{
  margin:0 0 14px 20px;
  color:var(--ink-soft);
  font-size:15px;
}
.legal-page li{margin-bottom:6px;}
.legal-page a{color:var(--amber-deep); text-decoration:underline;}
.legal-page .legal-box{
  background:var(--paper-raised);
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--radius);
  padding:22px 26px;
  margin-bottom:24px;
}
.legal-page .legal-box p{margin-bottom:4px;}
.legal-note{
  font-size:13px;
  color:var(--steel);
  background:var(--amber-tint);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,122,26,0.3);
  border-radius:10px;
  padding:14px 18px;
  margin-top:36px;
}

/* footer */
footer{
  padding:20px 0 44px;
  text-align:center;
}
.footer-sticker{
  width:128px;
  margin:0 auto 18px;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 14px 26px rgba(18,32,58,0.18));
}
footer .legal{font-size:13px; color:var(--steel); line-height:1.7;}

/* reveal animation */
.reveal{opacity:0; transform:translateY(16px); transition:opacity .6s ease, transform .6s ease;}
.reveal.in{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0);}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
  .reveal{opacity:1; transform:none; transition:none;}
  html{scroll-behavior:auto;}
}

/* ---------- responsive ---------- */
@media (max-width: 900px){
  .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .services-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
  .machines-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
  .process{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .process-step:not(:last-child){border-right:none; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .about{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .kontakt{grid-template-columns:1fr; padding:44px 26px;}
}

@media (max-width: 680px){
  nav{
    position:fixed; top:71px; left:0; right:0;
    background:var(--paper-raised);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
    flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start;
    padding:20px 28px 26px;
    gap:16px;
    transform:translateY(-8px);
    opacity:0; pointer-events:none;
    transition:opacity .18s ease, transform .18s ease;
  }
  nav.open{opacity:1; pointer-events:auto; transform:translateY(0);}
  nav .btn{width:100%;}
  .hamburger{
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:9px;
    border:1px solid var(--line); background:transparent;
  }
  .hamburger span{display:block; width:18px; height:2px; background:var(--ink); position:relative;}
  .hamburger span::before, .hamburger span::after{
    content:""; position:absolute; left:0; width:18px; height:2px; background:var(--ink);
  }
  .hamburger span::before{top:-6px;}
  .hamburger span::after{top:6px;}
  .services-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .machines-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .keypad{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
  .trustbar-inner{flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start;}
  .wizard-card{padding:28px 20px;}
  .branche-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .form-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .form-field-full{grid-column:1;}
  .wizard-step-dot{min-width:56px; font-size:10.5px;}
  .wizard-step-line{max-width:24px;}
}
</style>

      <h2 style="margin-bottom:16px; font-size:clamp(26px,3.2vw,34px);">Immer gut ausgestattet — auch beim Bezahlen.</h2>
      <p>Ihr Team soll sich um eins kümmern: die Pause genießen. Deshalb statten wir jeden Automaten mit modernen, bargeldlosen Zahlungssystemen aus — schnell, zuverlässig und ohne Kleingeld-Suche.</p>
      <ul class="fresh-list">
        <li>Karte und kontaktloses Bezahlen (girocard, Kreditkarte)</li>

      <h2 style="margin-bottom:18px; font-size:clamp(26px,3.2vw,34px);">Zwei Inhaber, ein direkter Draht zu Ihnen.</h2>
      <p>SnackBreak — Have a Break, Have a SnackBreak wird als Handelsgesellschaft GbR von Spiros Bogiatzidis und Timm Emanuel geführt. Seit 2024 betreuen wir Automaten-Standorte im Rhein-Erft-Kreis sowie in Köln und Düsseldorf, darunter auch Gewerbekunden.</p>
      <p>Weil wir zu zweit für alle Standorte verantwortlich sind, kennen wir jeden Automaten persönlich — und Sie erreichen bei Fragen immer direkt einen von uns, nicht ein Callcenter.</p>
      <div class="founders">

<section id="faq">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="section-head reveal">
      <span class="section-eyebrow">HÄUFIGE FRAGEN</span>
      <h2>Kurz erklärt, bevor Sie fragen müssen.</h2>
      <p>Die wichtigsten Punkte für Unternehmen, die zum ersten Mal mit uns starten.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="faq-list reveal">
      <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>Was kostet die Aufstellung eines Automaten?</summary>
        <div class="faq-answer">Die Aufstellung und der Anschluss sind für Sie kostenlos. Nach einem kurzen Gespräch zu Standort und Teamgröße erhalten Sie ein individuelles Angebot für Befüllung und Betreuung.</div>
      </details>
      <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>Wie oft wird der Automat befüllt?</summary>
        <div class="faq-answer">Das legen wir gemeinsam fest — je nach Teamgröße und Verbrauch, meist im wöchentlichen Rhythmus. Sollte etwas schneller zur Neige gehen, passen wir den Turnus einfach an.</div>
      </details>
      <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>Können wir das Sortiment mitbestimmen?</summary>
        <div class="faq-answer">Ja. Wir stimmen die Auswahl aus Snacks, Getränken und ggf. Bio-Optionen auf die Vorlieben Ihres Teams ab und passen sie bei Bedarf jederzeit an.</div>
      </details>
      <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>Welche Zahlungsmethoden werden unterstützt?</summary>
        <div class="faq-answer">Karte, kontaktlos und Smartphone-Zahlung (Apple Pay, Google Pay) sind Standard. Auf Wunsch bleibt auch Bargeld möglich.</div>
      </details>
      <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>Was passiert, wenn der Automat mal streikt?</summary>
        <div class="faq-answer">Sie melden sich direkt bei Timm oder Spiros — per Anruf oder WhatsApp. Kein Callcenter, keine Warteschleife, sondern ein schneller, persönlicher Draht zu uns.</div>
      </details>
      <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>In welchen Regionen seid ihr aktiv?</summary>

            <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary wizard-next" data-next="3">Weiter</button>

        <div class="wizard-panel" data-panel="3">
          <h3>Wie erreichen wir Sie?</h3>
          <div class="form-grid">
            <label class="form-field">
              <span>Ihr Name *</span>

            </label>
            <label class="form-field">
              <span>E-Mail *</span>

            <label class="form-field form-field-full">

          <div class="wizard-actions">
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline wizard-back" data-back="2">Zurück</button>
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" id="wizardSubmit">Anfrage per E-Mail senden</button>

          <p class="wizard-note">Unverbindlich &amp; kostenlos — Antwort innerhalb von 24 Stunden.</p>

    &nbsp;·&nbsp;

  </div>
</footer>

<script>
  // mobile nav toggle
  const hamburgerBtn = document.getElementById('hamburgerBtn');
  const mainNav = document.getElementById('mainNav');
  if(hamburgerBtn){
    hamburgerBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const open = mainNav.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
    });
    mainNav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a => {
      a.addEventListener('click', () => {
        mainNav.classList.remove('open');
        hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      });
    });
  }

  // scroll reveal
  const revealEls = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
  const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if(entry.isIntersecting){
        entry.target.classList.add('in');
        io.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, {threshold:0.15});
  revealEls.forEach(el => io.observe(el));

  // anfrage wizard
  (function(){
    const form = document.getElementById('anfrageForm');
    if(!form) return;

    const panels = form.querySelectorAll('.wizard-panel');
    const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.wizard-step-dot');
    let currentStep = 1;

    function showStep(step){
      panels.forEach(p => p.classList.toggle('active', Number(p.dataset.panel) === step));
      dots.forEach(d => {
        const n = Number(d.dataset.dot);
        d.classList.toggle('active', n === step);
        d.classList.toggle('done', n < step);
      });
      currentStep = step;
      hideError(step);
    }

    function showError(step){
      const err = form.querySelector('.wizard-error[data-error="' + step + '"]');
      if(err) err.style.display = 'block';
    }
    function hideError(step){
      const err = form.querySelector('.wizard-error[data-error="' + step + '"]');
      if(err) err.style.display = 'none';
    }

    function validateStep(step){
      if(step === 1){
        return !!form.querySelector('input[name="branche"]:checked');
      }
      if(step === 2){
        return form.querySelector('input[name="firma"]').value.trim().length > 0;
      }
      if(step === 3){
        const name = form.querySelector('input[name="name"]').value.trim();
        const email = form.querySelector('input[name="email"]').value.trim();
        return name.length > 0 && /\S+@\S+\.\S+/.test(email);
      }
      return true;
    }

    form.querySelectorAll('.wizard-next').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if(validateStep(currentStep)){
          showStep(Number(btn.dataset.next));
        } else {
          showError(currentStep);
        }
      });
    });

    form.querySelectorAll('.wizard-back').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        showStep(Number(btn.dataset.back));
      });
    });

    function collectData(){
      const branche = form.querySelector('input[name="branche"]:checked');
      return {
        branche: branche ? branche.value : 'nicht angegeben',
        firma: form.querySelector('input[name="firma"]').value.trim() || 'nicht angegeben',
        standort: form.querySelector('input[name="standort"]').value.trim() || 'nicht angegeben',
        teamgroesse: form.querySelector('select[name="teamgroesse"]').value || 'nicht angegeben',
        name: form.querySelector('input[name="name"]').value.trim(),
        email: form.querySelector('input[name="email"]').value.trim(),
        telefon: form.querySelector('input[name="telefon"]').value.trim() || 'nicht angegeben',
        nachricht: form.querySelector('textarea[name="nachricht"]').value.trim() || '(keine Angabe)'
      };
    }

    function buildBody(d){
      return 'Neue Anfrage über die Website:\n\n' +
        'Bereich: ' + d.branche + '\n' +
        'Firma: ' + d.firma + '\n' +
        'Standort/PLZ: ' + d.standort + '\n' +
        'Teamgröße: ' + d.teamgroesse + '\n\n' +
        'Name: ' + d.name + '\n' +
        'E-Mail: ' + d.email + '\n' +
        'Telefon: ' + d.telefon + '\n\n' +
        'Nachricht:\n' + d.nachricht;
    }

    form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      if(!validateStep(3)){
        showError(3);
        return;
      }
      const d = collectData();
      const subject = 'Angebot anfordern — ' + d.firma;
      const body = buildBody(d);
      const mailto = 'mailto:officialsnackbreak@gmail.com?subject=' + encodeURIComponent(subject) + '&body=' + encodeURIComponent(body);
      window.location.href = mailto;
    });

    const waBtn = document.getElementById('wizardWhatsapp');
    if(waBtn){
      waBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if(!validateStep(3)){
          showError(3);
          return;
        }
        const d = collectData();
        const text = buildBody(d);
        const wa = 'https://wa.me/4915752850757?text=' + encodeURIComponent(text);
        window.open(wa, '_blank', 'noopener');
      });
    }
  })();
</script>

</body>
